## What this changes

A short description and, for behaviour changes, the CHANGELOG line.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run check` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes, with tests added in the layer that can observe the change
- [ ] A new plugin has a DOM test file of the same name and a reference page
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` "Unreleased" is updated for anything a user can observe
- [ ] `npm run size` has been run and the sizes recorded, if `src` changed
- [ ] The code is original: nothing copied or adapted from another library
